'''The Sail Barge Gardens''', or Doe See'ybark Bootana in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], was an exclusive restaurant in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. Some sections of the restaurant featured items and parts from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']]. The Gardens were known for their excellent but expensive food.
